## Result

Adds an unreviewed Slot 05 research report that rederives the one-source-arm-per-contact-edge lemma and applies it to current Target A Sections 175–177.

In the Section-168 zero-slack branch, it improves the Section-176.6 source-localization exception from `5|V(Sigma)| + 12d + 9` to `|E(Sigma)| + 8d + 1`. In the simultaneous zero-slack / Section-172 locked-fan branch, it proves the conditional bounds

- `sum_i |O_i| + P_Sigma <= |E(Sigma)| + 28d + 26`;
- `rank(S) <= |T_Sigma| + |E(Sigma)| + 28d + 26 - P_Sigma`;
- `h(G) >= |O| - |T_Sigma| - |E(Sigma)| - 28d - 26 + P_Sigma + Q_Sigma`.

For the locked fan it combines this with the prescribed-phase Voronoi tube estimate and gives an exact conditional closure criterion. The report keeps the independent source matchings separate, includes all source labels, and does not change canonical theorem state. The right-sector surplus condition remains open.

The report also records an exact unit-lozenge regression: even with the Section-164 common-lattice-neighbor witness and all four strict lattice neighbors of the source point, the two gate endpoints can remain more than one unit apart. This rules out a data-only repair that converts every source gate directly into a Schur edge; it is not a full canonical counterexample.

The report also gives a full-dimensional four-point fixed-hull example, certified by shared Oler Lemma 21.1, where distinct remaining source labels block the two compatible gate endpoints. Thus fixed-hull maximality alone does not yield a two-for-one exchange.

A closed noncanonical PR (#645) contains related prior work. This branch rechecks the proof against current `main` (`ab6dd333`, state `2026-10-10.audit.234`) and preserves it as an audit-ready report; it does not import that branch as a dependency.
